q_1758428269182_benpefmi9: True airspeed corrects indicated airspeed for air density, in an inverse relationship. As the aircraft climbs, air density decreases. If IAS is increasing, TAS will increase with it. If IAS is constant, TAS will increase. Even if IAS is decreasing, TAS can still increase if IAS decreases slower than air density does. The missing information is how fast is the aircraft climbing relative to its acceleration.
